results.name: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the ball of your front foot raised on a block.
Square your hips forward.
Hinge forward over the front leg.
Hold, feeling the stretch in your calf and hamstring, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your heel down on the floor.
Go only as far as is comfortable.
results.description: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Pyramid Prayer
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the back foot turned out slightly.
Join your palms behind your back in a reverse prayer, or hold your elbows.
Hinge forward over the front leg with a long spine.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Hold your elbows if reverse prayer is too intense.
Keep your chest open.
results.description: Pyramid Prayer is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.

results.name: Reclining Pigeon Pose
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh.
Pull the lower leg toward your chest by holding behind the thigh.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Flex the foot of the crossed leg to protect the knee.
results.description: Reclining Pigeon Pose is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Abduction
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Keep your hands extended by your sides with hands firm on the floor.
Engage your core and glutes, and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
While holding the bridge position, press your knees outward against the resistance band to stretch them as far as possible.
Slowly bring your knees back together, then lower your hips back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back; keep a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Focus on engaging your glutes and hip abductors throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips and press your knees outward, and inhale as you bring your knees back together and lower your hips .
results.description: Resistance Band Glute Bridge Abduction is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Abductors, Core, Hamstrings.

results.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge (Version 2)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Bring your hands close to your chest and interlock your fingers.
Engage your core and glutes, and lift your hips towards the ceiling, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Hold the bridge position for a moment, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back; keep a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Focus on engaging your glutes throughout the movement.
Exhale as you lift your hips and press your knees outward, and inhale as you bring your knees back together and lower your hips .
results.description: Resistance Band Glute Bridge (Version 2) is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Core, Hamstrings, Abductors.

results.name: Resistance Band Upper Body Dead Bug
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle, knees right above your hips. Attach two loop resistance bands at a low point, extending behind you.
Hold the end of each band in each hand, keeping your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower your right leg towards the floor while keeping your left leg and arms in the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you lower your leg and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor to avoid strain.
Focus on engaging your core muscles throughout the movement.
results.description: Resistance Band Upper Body Dead Bug is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs
instructions: Sit and stack one knee on top of the other, with your feet beside your hips.
Sit evenly on both sit bones.
Fold forward over your knees, or stay upright.
Hold, breathing slowly, then switch the top leg.
tips: Sit on a cushion if your hips are tight.
Don't force your knees together.
results.description: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Reverse Prayer
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Bring your hands behind your back and join your palms with your fingers pointing up.
Press your palms together and open your chest.
Hold, breathing slowly.
tips: Hold opposite elbows as an easier version.
Keep your shoulders back.
results.description: Reverse Prayer is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner
instructions: Step into a lunge and lower your back knee to the floor.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and place your opposite elbow outside your front knee.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Keep the back knee down for stability.
Twist gradually with each breath.
results.description: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands
instructions: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your opposite elbow outside your front knee.
Hold, then switch sides.
tips: Lengthen your spine before you twist.
Lower your back knee to make it easier.
results.description: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hip Flexors.
